rows.en: Furuhashi, Shiro Kazami or Joji Yuki is defeated
Dan Moroboshi is defeated

So this is it? The excavation site we were asked to guard…

Ah… Dr. Iwamoto!?
Hello there, thanks for coming…
Huh… So this is the mummy in question?
It came out of that cave… Judging from the murals, I'd say it's at least 7,000 years old…
7,000 years…?

For a mummy 7,000 years old, it has kept its original form remarkably well…

Is the secret in that cave? Or… is there some hidden mystery in the mummy itself? Either way, I think we'll get some interesting results.
Would it be all right if we took a look at the cave?
Yes, go ahead… The rock is crumbly, so please be careful.
What's that?

A mural, isn't it…? It's too big to make out well, but I'll bet that mummy drew it.

What could it be? A giant horse… no, it looks like a dragon, doesn't it?
The mummy, holding the secrets of 7,000 years, was laid for the time being in a room at the Science Center, and the Science Patrol went along as guards!
That night… at this point, not a single person had even imagined that a truly horrifying incident was about to occur…
Uuugh…
Guoooooh…

…!?

Hy-hyaaah!!
Waaaaaagh!!

Science Patrol here…

Uh-huh, uh-huh… Roger! We of the Science Patrol will begin investigating at once!
What's going on?
They say the mummy has disappeared.
The mummy has…?
That's right.

Hey, Ide…

Report accurately! In this case, see… shouldn't you correct that to "the mummy was stolen by someone"?

Actually, no correction needed. Listen up, Arashi.

The murdered guard clearly left signs of having struggled with the mummy…

Which means… the mummy revived from some kind of shock, killed the guard and escaped.

And what's more… what's more, after that, two policemen were attacked at the entrance to the sewers…
Understood! We'll rush there and start our investigation!

Dr. Iwamoto… So you were here after all?

To get straight to the point…

Why did a dead mummy come back to life… right?

I've been getting the same question nonstop since this morning. To give you the conclusion first… that mummy was alive.

What…!? It was alive?

But, Doctor… you announced that at least 7,000 years had passed since its death.
Then… shall I correct that to "he was alive while dead"? He was in a kind of hibernation.
That's hard to believe…
We've driven the mummy to the area near the sewage treatment plant! Please rush to the scene at once!

Wait!!

Capture the mummy alive if at all possible! If you attack it with those new weapons of yours, even a mummy won't stand a chance.

If you capture it alive… we can solve the mystery of how it kept its life for 7,000 years. Don't forget that!
Doctor… I may be an ace with the Spider Shot, but I won't fire it unless I absolutely have to!
Mm, I'm counting on you!
The mummy is in here?

Yes, sir…

However… at Dr. Iwamoto's request, we are to capture it alive!
Mm, we've heard as well… But I wonder if it will go well?
All right, commence Operation Mummy Capture!!
How good of you to come, Goro Watari… Now, allow us to give you the warmest of welcomes. Hwa ha ha ha…

Heh heh heh…

Well? How do you like the effect of our enhanced Psychic Power Nullifier Ring?

Goro Watari… I'll make you into a member of the Desper Army!

Take Goro Watari to the operating room!
Sir…

Mr. Arai…

Was it around here that Goro was carried off by the Desper Army?
Yeah, no doubt about it… There must be an entrance to their secret base somewhere.
Understood… Let's split up and search!
Officer Katsube!!
Officer Hirata!!
Officer Omura!!
Officer Yanagiya!!
There's nothing we can do like this, is there? Let's give up on capturing it alive… All right, commence attack!!
The Desper Army…!? So they showed up after all!?
Kyaaaaah…
What…!? Seriously?
What…!? Seriously?
In the end we couldn't capture it alive. If only we hadn't dug up that mummy, it could have gone on sleeping…
I'm sure he… was trying to go back home.
Science Patrol here…
What did you say!?
What's wrong?

Cap, it's terrible!

Now a kaiju has appeared near the sewage treatment plant.
A kaiju…?
That's right…
What's its current position?
It seems to be rampaging at that sewage treatment plant.
Hayata! Sortie in the Jet VTOL!
Kiiiiih, kiiiiih!
So you're saying the kaiju appeared because the mummy called out to it?
I think they called to each other by telepathy.
Telepathy?
If Fuji's theory is right, then the kaiju appeared to save the mummy… Is that it?

This is Hayata… Cap, I've found the kaiju!

It's rampaging with weird rays just like the mummy's!
What a terrifying monster…

This is bad! We have to stop it there…

The Security Unit officers were injured by those weird rays too! We can't afford any more casualties!

Damn… An eye for an eye!

We'll take out its eyes before it can fire those weird rays! That's the only way… Cap, let's do it!!
Stop! Have you forgotten how powerful those weird rays are!?

But…

nearby, the Amigo crew are fighting the Desper Army to rescue Goro! We have to stop it here, no matter what…

Ide, bring out the Mars 133!

I've been waiting for this!!

I secretly built it just in case something like this happened! The Mars 133… It should pack quite a punch.
The <c2>Mars 133</c>…?
It's a new weapon Ide invented! I swear we won't die for nothing…
